title: First Schedule, Part II (classification of offences against other laws) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023

fields.band: id of the punishment band, built by rule from the printed offence cell (part2_band)
fields.death / life / fine_only: whether the offence cell names death, imprisonment for life, or 'fine only'
fields.min_years / min_inclusive: lower bound in years: 'more than N years' (exclusive) or 'N years and upwards' (inclusive)
fields.max_years / max_inclusive: upper bound in years: 'not more than N years' (inclusive) or 'less than N years' (exclusive)
fields.cognisable / bailable / triable_by: the cells with 'Ditto' replaced by the cell above, read as flags
